title: Paterculus
summary: Raleigh names Paterculus in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Paterculus, who reckons the time of Homer from the Consulship of Marcus Vinutius. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book II, Part I, Chapter XVI, §. VII, sig. 291b–292a
